title: ARISE Herbarium Plant DNA Extraction
author: Kevin Beentjes
materials: Tissue Sampling Note: For high throughput, DNA extraction can be performed in plates rather than individual tubes. Within ARISE plant tissues are processed in Qiagen Collection Microtubes (Qiagen cat no. 19560) plates, which fit into a TissueLyser using plate adapters. Place up to 0.5 cm 2 of silica dried leaf tissue into a plate of collection microtubes or 1.5 ml eppendorf tubes. Tissues other than leaf may work with unverified success rates. Optional: Grind tissue with a tube pestle, tweezers or cut the tissue with a scalpel. Make sure the tissue is broken up into smaller pieces to allow efficient maceration. Add three sterile 2mm glass beads per sample.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer A
steps.instruction: In a 100 mL volumetric flask add 13.4 mL of 1 M Tris‑HCl (pH 8) to 50 mL Milli‑Q water, then add 10.6 mL of 0.5 M EDTA (pH 8). Stir until dissolved, adjust the pH to 9.0 with NaOH, and bring the final volume to 100 mL with Milli‑Q water.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer B
steps.instruction: In a 100 mL flask add 3.4 g guanidine thiocyanate and 17.4 g trisodium phosphate dodecahydrate to 50 mL Milli‑Q water, then add 0.4 g sodium chloride. Stir on a heated magnetic stirrer until all solids dissolve, adjust the pH to 9.0 with HCl, and bring the volume to 100 mL with Milli‑Q water.

steps.title: Prepare 15 % Tween‑20 Additive
steps.instruction: Mix 15 mL Tween‑20 with 85 mL Milli‑Q water (total 100 mL). Stir gently to avoid bubble formation.

steps.title: Prepare Tissue Binding Buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve 26.3 g guanidine hydrochloride in 20 mL Milli‑Q water, stir until clear, adjust the volume to 50 mL with Milli‑Q water, then add 50 mL 100 % ethanol (final volume 100 mL).

steps.title: Prepare Elution Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 1 M Tris‑HCl (pH 8) to 75 mL Milli‑Q water, then add 0.2 mL of 0.5 M EDTA (pH 8). Bring the volume to 100 mL with Milli‑Q water, vortex or stir briefly to mix.

steps.title: Heat Buffers to Dissolve Salts (if needed)
steps.instruction: If salts in Lysis Buffer B or Tissue Binding Buffer have crystallized, heat the affected buffer at approximately 55 °C for 10 minutes or until the salts are fully dissolved.

steps.title: Calibrate Tissue Binding Buffer pH
steps.instruction: Mix 2.17 mL Lysis Buffer A, 2.17 mL Lysis Buffer B, 330 µL Milli‑Q water and 330 µL 15 % Tween‑20 (total 5 mL). Add 10 mL Tissue Binding Buffer to this mixture in a 50 mL tube, then adjust to pH 4.0‑4.5 with 5 M HCl while stirring at room temperature. Record the volume of HCl added (≈350 µL). Dispose of the calibration mixture. For each 10 mL of Tissue Binding Buffer to be used, add the same volume of 5 M HCl recorded (e.g., 350 µL per 10 mL; thus 3.5 mL HCl for 100 mL). Verify the pH by mixing 10 mL Tissue Binding Buffer with 5 mL fresh lysis mixture and measuring; repeat adjustments until the combined Lysis Buffer A + B mixture reaches pH 4.0‑4.5. If a new batch of Lysis Buffer B is prepared, repeat the verification step.

steps.title: Optional Physical Lysis of Samples
steps.instruction: Dip the ends of the sample plate or tube in liquid nitrogen for a few seconds, repeat until the contents are frozen. Then place the frozen samples in a TissueLyser and run for 150 seconds at 30 Hz. Centrifuge the lysed material for 15 minutes at maximum speed.

steps.title: Add Lysis Reagents to Plant Tissue
steps.instruction: To each powdered herbarium plant sample add 50 µL Lysis Buffer A, 50 µL Lysis Buffer B, 7.7 µL 15 % Tween‑20 additive, and 5 µL RNase A (12 mg mL⁻¹). Mix with a TissueLyser for 30 seconds at 30 Hz, then centrifuge for 2 minutes at maximum speed to collect the lysate at the bottom of the tube or plate.

steps.title: Incubate for RNase Activation
steps.instruction: Place the lysed samples on a shaking incubator set to 37 °C and 400 RPM for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Incubate Overnight for DNA Release
steps.instruction: After the 37 °C step, incubate the samples at 55 °C and 400 RPM overnight on a shaking incubator. Samples may be stored at 4 °C after incubation if needed.

steps.title: Bind DNA to Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the incubated samples for 15 minutes at maximum speed at room temperature to pellet solid debris. Transfer 75 µL of the clear supernatant to a new deep‑well plate or tube, add 20 µL MagAttract Suspension G beads (pre‑shaken to resuspend), then add 150 µL Tissue Binding Buffer (2 × lysate volume). Incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature on a shaker.

steps.title: Wash Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Place the tube/plate on a magnetic rack, allow beads to collect, and discard the supernatant. Remove from the magnet and add 500 µL isopropanol; shake at room temperature at 500 RPM for 2 minutes. Settle beads on the magnet and discard the isopropanol. Add 400 µL 96 % ethanol, settle, discard supernatant. Repeat the 400 µL ethanol wash once more (total two ethanol washes). Remove all residual ethanol and dry the beads for 5‑10 minutes at room temperature (or 50 °C).

steps.title: Elute DNA from Beads
steps.instruction: Add 50‑70 µL Elution Buffer (or Milli‑Q water) to each bead suspension, shake at 500 RPM for at least 5 minutes. Place the tube/plate on the magnetic rack, allow beads to settle, and transfer the cleared supernatant containing DNA to a new plate or tube.
